description: Player report: the green dashed movement-reach ring marked where the model's CENTRE could stop, so a wide base visibly poked outside the ring at max range and read as a bug. The ring must instead mark where the model's BASE EDGE can reach — i.e. be inflated by Measurement.base_extent_px(model). Driven live on U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I (100mm base, M8), repositioned onto verified open ground at (1280,1310) — a corridor probed live against TerrainManager: calculate_movement_terrain_penalty((1280,1310)->(1600,1310)) == 0.0 (no difficult-ground tax to eat into the 8" budget) and model_overlaps_any_wall / model_outside_board are false at both ends. Real player path: click the token to begin the Normal Move, then a real mouse drag PAUSED mid-flight (release:false) exactly 8" to the right, so the live frame can be inspected while the model sits at max range. Asserts: (1) one dashed ring is drawn (8 dashes + label); (2) the model's base extent is a visually significant ~79px (a 2" overhang under the old drawing); (3) the ring radius equals move-cap px PLUS the base extent, and exceeds the raw move cap by that extent; (4) the drag really travelled the full 8" and the move is still legal (path_valid); (5) THE FIX: at that legal max-range position the furthest point of the model's base sits ON the ring (|radius - (moved + extent)| <= 1.5px) instead of ~79px outside it; (6) the label still reports the movement distance (8"), not the drawn radius.

steps.script:
# Frame the whole ring: world (1440,1310) — the midpoint of the drag — at
# screen centre, zoom 1.2. Ring radius is ~399 board px -> ~479 screen px,
# so the whole ring clears 1920x1080.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.2
m.view_offset = Vector2(1440.0, 1310.0) - Vector2(960.0, 540.0) / 1.2
m.update_view_transform()
return true

# The paused drag really is at max range (8").
var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var moved: float = mc.current_path[1].distance_to(mc.drag_start_pos) / Measurement.PX_PER_INCH
return abs(moved - mc.move_cap_inches)
